summary: A mayor reports in the address that the city has announced it will fight a higher government's funding threat, and weeks later the city is a named plaintiff.
realLife: Harrell's 2025 State of the City said the city had announced it would join a lawsuit over withheld federal funds tied to sanctuary status. Seattle was added as a plaintiff through an amended complaint filed February 27, 2025, with 10 other cities and counties, in a case first filed February 7 by San Francisco and others.
sources: Read the speech text and the city's release. The speech reports the announcement; the release gives the filing.
inGame: The city executive engine's lawsuit-join record and the funding row it protects.

turns.what: The city files nothing and negotiates with the higher government.
turns.pulledBy: a mayor dependent on one grant
turns.writesBack: The grant record shows a signed agreement and no case.

turns.what: The city submits a supporting statement but is not a plaintiff.
turns.pulledBy: a city attorney who is not on board
turns.writesBack: The court record lists the city as a supporter.
